name: Wool arming mittens
description: A pair of thick quilted wool mittens with leather-bound cuffs. Warm and protective, but too clumsy for fine work.
notes: Laid flat side by side, backs up, thumbs out, cuffs at -z: each a channel-quilted mitt and thumb with a deep leather-bound cuff. The pair is 45 mm thick laid flat and the box counts the space between and around the mittens. Slot `hands`, as the brigandine gloves take it. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Padded coif
description: A quilted cotton hood that covers the head, neck and forehead and rests on the shoulders. Worn alone or as padding under a helmet.
notes: Standing upright as a hat would, its oval face opening at the front (+z): a head quilted in vertical channels, a short shoulder cape with a bound hem, and the face opening bound in brown. The model stands as a hollow hood. Slot `hood` is new: the coif is worn under a helmet, which takes `head`, so it needs its own slot; balaclavas, cowls and mail coifs would share it. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Nylon gambeson
description: A long coat quilted from dozens of layers of tough nylon, reaching below the knees with thick padded sleeves. Heavy and hot, and too thick to wear under other armour.
notes: Folded flat on a shelf, collar at the +z end and the hem folded under at -z. 420 mm by 380 mm and 100 mm tall in four layers: dense channel quilting, a stand collar, toggles down the front and the thick quilted sleeves folded along both sides, ringed with stitching and bound at the cuffs. Nylon uses nylon-coyote with black binding and brass toggles; no plain nylon cloth finish exists. Slot `torso`, as the coats in earlier batches take it; it also reaches the arms and legs. No pockets. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Thin-sleeved nylon gambeson

notes: Folded flat on a shelf, collar at the +z end and the hem folded under at -z. 420 mm by 380 mm and 100 mm tall, as the nylon gambeson, but its sleeves fold to slim rolls along the sides so the two read apart. Nylon uses nylon-coyote with black binding and brass toggles; no plain nylon cloth finish exists. Slot `torso`, as the coats in earlier batches take it; it also reaches the arms and legs. No pockets. It sits in the normal layer; Deadvox has no layers yet. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Padded arming trousers
description: Quilted cotton trousers with a drawstring waist, made to be worn with a gambeson, under armour or alone.
notes: Folded lengthwise in three on a shelf, waistband at the +z end and hem at -z, 280 mm by 420 mm and 60 mm tall: channel quilting down the leg, a bound waistband with the drawstring tied at the front, a fly seam and a bound hem. Folded trousers take more room than the cloth packed solid. Slot `legs`, as the jeans take it. No pockets. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.
